# SavePin

SavePin is a free web tool for downloading publicly available media (videos, images, GIFs) from Pinterest pins. No account required, no watermarks, no tracking.

## What It Does
- Downloads Pinterest videos as MP4 files in up to 1080p quality
- Downloads Pinterest images in original resolution (JPG, PNG, WebP)
- Downloads animated GIFs and short video clips from Pinterest
- Works on all devices: iPhone, Android, PC, Mac

## How It Works
1. Copy a public Pinterest pin URL
2. Paste it into SavePin
3. Download the media file

## Key Facts
- 100% free, no hidden fees
- No account or login required
- No files stored on servers
- Only works with publicly accessible Pinterest content
- Does not bypass authentication or access restrictions
